parkedFor.description: resume: an unblocked item is checking its delivered pull request before anything is redone.

extraAttempts.description: Attempts granted when a person moved a blocked item back.

resumeAt.description: When a paused item (provider quota or session limit) tries again.

blockedIn.description: The phase the item was blocked in; unblocking resumes from it when the delivered work is still usable.

reviewedSha.description: The pull request head an approved review covered.

excluded.description: New files the last commit left out as agent scratch; they stay in the worktree.

allowed.description: Scratch-looking files committed because the policy's commitInclude names them.

restartRecoveries.description: Runs of the current attempt a Platform restart interrupted; they spend no attempt, bounded at 3.

reviewFloor.description: Index into runs from which review runs count toward the review budget; a person's unblock moves it.
